tooltip.yanyang_easement.easement_shape_: Use on a rail node to cycle the easement shape of its rails: classic, cubic parabola, half-wave sine. Sneak to cycle backwards.
message.yanyang_easement.no_rails: No rails connected to this node
message.yanyang_easement.no_permission: You don't have permission to modify rails
message.yanyang_easement.regen_hint: Trains will follow the new shape after regenerating paths at the depot. Single rails can also be edited with the Rail Data Editor (key: rail_shape).
